fonts.usage: Headings, primary display text, brand mark
Body text, navigation, labels, data tables, terminal output

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Unbounded for high-impact display and JetBrains Mono for everything else. Keep text alignment left. Letter-spacing tight for headings.

colors.instructions: Monochrome palette ONLY. No colorful gradients except inside the MacBook functional icons. Use pure white, deep black, and slate grays for structure.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #333333 on all containers and cards
visual_enhancers.radius: 0px or max 2px for terminal feel, pill CTAs are the ONLY exception (rounded-full)
visual_enhancers.ascii_art: Use ASCII art for loaders, 404s, and structural separators.

brand_logo.description: Distinctive infinity logo system, geometrically simple, monochrome-first, recognizable at 16px, hard-edged terminal aesthetic.
brand_logo.svg_code: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="square"><path d="M8 8 C 4 8, 4 16, 8 16 C 12 16, 12 8, 16 8 C 20 8, 20 16, 16 16 C 12 16, 12 8, 8 8 Z"/></svg>
brand_logo.rules: Must be sharp-edged, strictly monochrome, usable in header and footer.

layouts.homepage: 30/70 split-screen. Left 30% is scrolling narrative text (Unbounded headers, JetBrains Mono body). Right 70% is a sticky, framed MacBook mockup. Above the MacBook sits a dropdown/pill selector for the 9 industries. Changing it updates the 30% text and the MacBook internal UI.
layouts.macbook_internal: Uses the blackish-grey gradient. Retain colorful functional icons inside the demo screen. Show AHI workflow.
layouts.waitlist: Forms must have 1px borders, square edges, pill submit button. Post-submission shows queue position and copyable referral link (MongoDB backed).
layouts.directory: Searchable/filterable grid of 49 connectors. 1px borders, dense data layout, JetBrains Mono.
layouts.roi_calculator: Interactive inputs and live updating results. Terminal style sliders or numeric inputs.

components.pill_cta: rounded-full bg-white text-black px-6 py-2 font-mono uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors
components.industry_selector: Pill-based tab list or sleek dropdown above the MacBook. border border-[#333333].
components.ahi_eye: Interactive pointer-following element. SVGs reacting to mousemove.

motion.general: Minimal, instant, mechanical. No bouncy spring animations.
motion.ahi_eye: Follows pointer using JS event listeners.
motion.macbook: Sticky positioned on scroll while the left side text scrolls past.

image_urls.notes: Use minimal external imagery. Rely on terminal UI, ASCII, and the MacBook frame.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for basic icons, keeping them sharp and minimal.
Set up Tailwind to use 'Unbounded' and 'JetBrains Mono'.
Implement the 30/70 split using CSS Grid (grid-cols-10, col-span-3 and col-span-7).
The Macbook component should have `position: sticky; top: 2rem;`.
Create the AHI Eye component tracking mouse using Framer Motion or pure React state.
Build the MongoDB waitlist backend in FastAPI with endpoints for signup and referral tracking.
Include <title>, <meta name='description'>, and OpenGraph tags in all routes for SEO/AEO.
Do NOT use invented claims/customer proof. Use realistic mechanical placeholder text if needed.
Procedural Canvas closing section should use a HTML5 Canvas or Three.js to render an ocean/wave effect in monochrome.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AAA contrast ratio with black and white. Minimum 7:1 for text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep borders 1px solid.
NEVER use placeholder URLs or AI emoji characters for icons.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use a complete `transparent` background in headers or overlays if content scrolls beneath them. Use a solid black or heavily blurred glass background (`bg-black/90 backdrop-blur`).
